title: April 2 anti-government protests in Amhara over abuses, arrests and restrictions
location: Kobo, Merawi, Denebcha and Jiga, Amhara Region (reported; per-locality boundaries and attendance not established)
scope: Several same-day protests reported in separate Amhara localities. Kept as a multi-locality candidate because reporting identifies common anti-government grievance; no headcount is assigned from aggregate regional descriptions.
participants_original: Tens of thousands reported across Amhara cities in a retrospective source; ACLED identifies protests in four towns but no locality counts.
threshold_50_evidence: Aggregate estimate cannot establish at least 50 in each named town; per-location threshold remains pending.

location.summary: Kobo, Merawi, Denebcha and Jiga; no finer sites.

participants.summary: The article says tens of thousands across Amhara cities, without allocating attendance by locality; ACLED has no count.

demands.summary: Opposition to abuse/arrests and restrictions; regional report also describes opposition to special-force dismantling, but that policy announcement came later and is not applied to this April 2 occurrence.

state_response.summary: The weekly entry does not specify state response for these specific April 2 protests.

notes: This is pre-April 6 activity and is not merged with subsequent protests against the regional special-force integration plan announced later.
open_questions: Per-town attendance, exact start/end, independent local sources and organizer remain unknown.

title: Amhara protests against regional special-force integration
location: Amhara Region; ACLED reports at least 18 localities, including Woldiya, Gondar, Debre Tabor, Merawi and other towns
scope: A policy-triggered multi-day wave beginning April 6; do not treat each mention as an independently verified threshold event or transfer one town’s estimate to another.
participants_original: Thousands reported across at least two towns on April 9; exact turnout for the other localities is not reported.
threshold_50_evidence: Reports of thousands in multiple towns support scale of the wave, but location-specific counts and whether every reported site reached 50 remain unresolved.

date.summary: Sources describe protests beginning April 6 and continuing through the following days.

location.summary: At least 18 locations in Amhara; named examples include Gondar, Woldiya, Merawi, Debre Tabor.

participants.summary: The tens-of-thousands figure is regional aggregate; Reuters reports thousands in at least two towns. No per-site allocation.

demands.summary: Opposition to dissolving/integrating Amhara regional special forces into federal security structures.

state_response.summary: Curfews, force deployments and protester deaths/injuries are reported in the wider wave; individual responses vary by locality and are not assigned to every site.

notes: This is later than April 2 and tied to a distinct announced integration policy. Armed clashes and reports of Fano activity are not coded as protest participation.
open_questions: Exact onset location-specific attendance, organizers and per-site response are not resolved; further site-by-site reporting would be needed.

title: Nekemte Orthodox Christian protest over government intervention in church affairs
scope: One public protest by Oromo Orthodox Christians; separate from Amhara integration demonstrations on the same date.
organizer: Oromo Orthodox Christians; organizer not identified
threshold_50_evidence: Reported attendance in the thousands at Nekemte supports the threshold.

demands.summary: Protesters accused the government of intervening in church affairs.

state_response.summary: No response reported in the cited entry.

notes: A state-directed grievance over government intervention in religious affairs is distinct from a political party rally.
open_questions: Independent contemporaneous corroboration, precise route and state response not found in current search.

title: Southern Tigray demonstrations over identity and administration
location: Raya Alamata, Ofela, Korem and Zata, Southern Tigray
scope: Separate same-day local demonstrations over identity/administrative status; no aggregate crowd transferred across towns.
threshold_50_evidence: No attendee count; threshold is unresolved separately for each locality.

location.summary: Raya Alamata, Ofela, Korem and Zata.

demands.summary: Protesters sought recognition of identity and self-administration.

state_response.summary: No response stated for these demonstrations.

notes: Kept distinct from Amhara-region protests over arrests/abuse and the later April 6 integration-policy wave.
open_questions: Threshold, organizing structure, duration and independent reporting by town remain unknown.

title: Bahir Dar and Debre Markos stay-at-home protest signals
location: Bahir Dar (April 24) and Debre Markos (April 25), Amhara Region
scope: Two city-specific reports of businesses closing in the morning; not presumed to be one synchronized public gathering. The reporting says routine activity resumed by midday.
organizer: Unidentified callers/leaflet authors; no organizer verified
participants_original: No public participants reported; shops and businesses reportedly closed for the morning.
threshold_50_evidence: No evidence of 50 people physically gathering; this may be a stay-at-home action outside the public-gathering threshold.

date.summary: Reported Bahir Dar April 24 and Debre Markos April 25.

demands.summary: Protest call/leaflets connected to opposition in the region, details limited.

notes: Recorded as a candidate for review, not a validated public gathering; stores closing is not interpreted as participant count.
open_questions: Whether public assembly occurred and whether the same organizers/demand linked the two dates remain unknown.
